title: Terms & Conditions
intro: These terms govern your use of the TravelSuite ERP website, software and services. By using them you agree to these terms.
sections: 1. Our services
TravelSuite ERP provides travel booking, ERP, website, AI automation and messaging software to travel businesses, either as a hosted cloud service or as a self-hosted license.
2. Accounts
You are responsible for keeping your login details secure and for all activity under your account. Tell us immediately if you suspect unauthorised access.
3. Fees and payment
Subscription fees are billed monthly or yearly in advance. License fees are paid once before installation. Prices exclude VAT and third-party supplier fees unless stated otherwise.
4. Your data
You own the data you enter into TravelSuite ERP. We process it only to provide the service, as described in our Privacy Policy.
5. Acceptable use
You must not use the service for unlawful activity, to send spam, or to attempt to access other customers' data or our systems without permission.
6. Third-party suppliers
Airline, hotel, payment and messaging providers are governed by your own agreements with them. We are not responsible for their availability, pricing or decisions.
7. Availability and support
We aim to keep cloud services available at all times and to announce planned maintenance in advance. Support is provided during office hours through WhatsApp, phone and email.
8. Termination
You may cancel at any time; the service continues until the end of the paid period. We may suspend accounts that breach these terms or remain unpaid.
9. Changes and governing law
We may update these terms and will notify customers of material changes. These terms are governed by the laws of Bangladesh.

title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy explains what information TravelSuite ERP collects, how we use it and the choices you have.
sections: 1. Information we collect
Contact details you share with us, such as name, agency name, email and phone number.
Account and billing information for customers of our service.
Basic usage data such as pages visited and device type, used to improve the website.
2. How we use information
To respond to demo requests and questions, provide and support the service, send invoices and important notices, and improve our products.
3. Your customers' data
Data about your travellers, agents and suppliers that you store in TravelSuite ERP belongs to you. We process it only on your instructions and never sell it.
4. Sharing
We share information only with service providers who help us run the service, such as hosting and messaging providers, and when required by law.
5. Security and retention
We use encryption, access controls and daily backups to protect data. We keep information only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law.
6. Your choices
You can ask us to access, correct or delete your personal information, or to stop sending marketing messages, by contacting us on WhatsApp.

title: Refund Policy
intro: We want you to be confident in choosing TravelSuite ERP. This policy explains when refunds are available.
sections: 1. Cloud subscriptions

Monthly plans can be cancelled at any time and are not refunded for the current month. Yearly plans cancelled within 14 days of the first payment receive a full refund, minus any setup work already delivered.
2. Lifetime licenses
Lifetime licenses can be refunded within 7 days of payment if installation has not started. After installation, licenses are not refundable.
3. Add-ons and custom work
Supplier integrations, mobile apps and custom development are quoted separately. Work already completed is not refundable.
4. Third-party fees
Fees paid to GDS, airline, hotel, payment gateway or messaging providers are set by those providers and are not refunded by us.
5. How to request a refund
Message us on WhatsApp with your agency name and invoice number. Approved refunds are paid to the original payment method within 10 working days.
